summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, reporting routine notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) under the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses the vesting of share awards under the company's long-term incentive plan and a subsequent sale of shares by a director. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is indicated. This is a standard insider transaction report, not triggering any special-situations classification.
